name: What water conservation features are common in green homes?

mainEntity.name: What water conservation features are common in green homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Low-flow fixtures, dual-flush toilets, greywater systems, rainwater harvesting, drought-tolerant landscaping, and smart irrigation controllers can cut water use by 40-60%. wbdg​
